{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_orders = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of real completed orders
mean_revenue = real_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()
mean_revenue"}
